    n[0] += 1

    w.plan_launch(plan or {})
    return w

    print(f"\n===== {tag}: exit {run.code}")
    for line in run.out.splitlines():
        if not line.startswith("STEP "):
            print("  |", line)
        else:
            print("  | STEP", line.split()[1])

    wrap.write_text(

        "lines = p.stdout.splitlines()\n"
        "if '--kind' in sys.argv and sys.argv[sys.argv.index('--kind')+1] == 'checker':\n"
        "    lines = lines[:-1]\n"
        "print('\\n'.join(lines)); sys.exit(p.returncode)\n")
    r = w.drive(*w.run_args(gate=None)[:0], "run", *w.common_flags(), "--store-link", str(w.link), "--launch", str(wrap),
                "--gov", str(w.gov), "--claude", str(w.claude))
    show("C checker-1 without a counts line", r, w,
         f"  steps: {[s['step'] for s in w.counts()['steps']]}\n  checker-1.counts.json: "
         f"{(w.audit_dir / 'checker-1.counts.json').read_text().strip()}")

if "D" in which:  # lines that are not JSON in HISTORY.jsonl, STARTS.log and AUDITS.log

    w.mem.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (w.mem / "HISTORY.jsonl").write_text('{"audit": "x", "commit": "' + w.audit_commit + '", "measured": true}\nnot json\n')

    with open(w.audits_log, "a") as f:
        f.write("garbage line\n")
    d = w.due()
    print(f"\n===== D due with junk lines: exit {d.code}\n" + "\n".join("  | " + x for x in d.out.splitlines()))
    r = w.go()
    show("D run with junk lines", r, w)

if "E" in which:  # the lock after a stop and after an unexpected end

    r = w.go()
    show("E1 stop at writer-1", r, w, f"  lock free after: {W.flock_free(w.mem / 'LOCK')}")
